description: This file defines the DatabaseLockBackend class for managing database-backed locks in Drupal, including methods for acquiring, releasing, and checking locks, as well as schema management for the semaphore table.

classes.name: DatabaseLockBackend
classes.description: A class implementing a database-backed lock system for Drupal, handling lock acquisition, release, and schema management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DatabaseLockBackend with a database connection and registers a shutdown function to release all locks.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Attempts to acquire a lock with a given name and timeout, extending existing locks if already held.

methods.name: lockMayBeAvailable
methods.description: Checks if a lock with a given name may be available by inspecting the semaphore table.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases a lock with a specified name.

methods.name: releaseAll
methods.description: Releases all locks held by this backend, optionally filtered by lock ID.

methods.name: ensureTableExists
methods.description: Ensures the semaphore table exists in the database, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: catchException
methods.description: Handles exceptions related to semaphore table issues, propagating if the table exists.

methods.name: normalizeName
methods.description: Normalizes lock names to ASCII and length constraints, hashing if necessary.

methods.name: schemaDefinition
methods.description: Defines the schema for the semaphore table used for locking.
